title: A calm palette for every screen.
description: Light is the default theme. Use the toggle to preview the dark token set.

colors.title: Semantic color tokens.
colors.description: A shared palette keeps application surfaces, actions and feedback consistent.

button.title: Actions with a clear hierarchy.
button.description: Filled, outlined, ghost and flat buttons across the application color tokens.

form.title: Clear inputs for confident setup.
form.description: Inputs, selections and field wrappers share the same semantic states.
form.notificationsDescription: A short reminder before an important update.
form.publicDescription: Anyone with the link can view it.
form.fieldWrappersDescription: The same controls can be connected to validation without changing their visual language.

alert.title: Inline feedback with semantic meaning.
alert.description: Alerts keep important context close to the action that needs attention.
alert.defaultDescription: Review the details before sharing it with your audience.
alert.infoDescription: The preview reflects your latest settings.
alert.successDescription: Your changes are ready for the next step.
alert.warningDescription: You have one project remaining on this plan.
alert.destructiveDescription: Check your connection and try again.

badge.title: Compact signals for status and context.
badge.description: Badges identify a state or category without competing with the main action.

skeleton.title: Quiet loading states for async content.
skeleton.description: Skeletons preserve layout while data is loading.

tooltip.title: Helpful context for compact controls.
tooltip.description: Tooltips clarify icon-only actions without adding permanent visual noise.

tabs.title: Group related content without losing context.
tabs.description: Tabs keep secondary views close while giving each one enough room to breathe.
tabs.overviewContent: A concise summary of the project and its current sharing state.
tabs.settingsContent: Configuration stays available without leaving the current workspace.
tabs.activityContent: Recent changes and publishing activity can live in a focused history view.

components.title: Patterns for grouping and focus.
components.description: Cards, accordions and dialogs provide structure without competing with the content.

card.title: Next important moment
card.description: A calm surface for related project details.
card.body: Cards keep related information and actions together.

accordion.firstContent: Use a card for a focused group of related content or actions.
accordion.secondContent: Use an accordion when secondary details should remain available without taking over the page.

dialog.title: Publish your project?
dialog.description: Review the details before sharing this project.
dialog.body: This is a focused surface for confirmation, editing or upgrade messaging.

toast.title: Feedback without interruption.

toast.warningDescription: You have one project remaining on this plan.
